sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Rotocasting Injection and Airbrush Finishing of Vinyl Art Collectibles

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2018, as amended; Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), codified at 4 MIRC §§ 101 et seq.; Registered Agents Act 1990; Beneficial Ownership Information Regulations 2020; Money Laundering (Prevention) Regulations, as amended.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly notarized and apostilled copy of each UBO passport bio-data page
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the UBO's country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified and apostilled proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or regulated bank in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized corporate resolutions or consent to act from incoming directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / company board of the appointing entity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory adverse-media, PEP, OFAC/SDN, UN Security Council, EU/UK consolidated, and RMI domestic sanctions screening for all UBOs, directors, and officers; enhanced due diligence for PEPs and close associates as defined under the AML/CTF Act 2018.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro; filings through licensed registered agents, with electronic pre-clearance portal for agents only)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered names must be in Latin script; English and Marshallese are the official languages. Non-Latin or UTF-8 character sets must be transliterated into standard A-Z characters, and diacritical marks are not permitted in the registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is rejected, the applicant files a written administrative appeal with the Registrar within 14 days of rejection, specifying the legal and factual grounds, and attaches a fresh name search report. The Registrar must issue a reasoned decision within 14 business days; a further appeal lies to the Minister of Trade and Commerce, and thereafter to the High Court, within 30 days of the ministerial decision, or as prescribed by the Business Corporations Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a non-resident business corporation: the company must maintain a registered agent and a registered office in the Marshall Islands solely at the agent's address; no physical staff or premises are required in the RMI, and manufacturing operations may be conducted overseas through independent contract manufacturers.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (less than 5% annual risk) for a non-resident entity with no local commercial presence; the Registrar and Financial Intelligence Unit rely primarily on registered-agent records and may inspect the registered agent's records rather than the company's physical premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and statutory name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation UBO due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / AML compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille of incorporation and UBO documents (per document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent apostille/consular authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff and consular/apostille fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office (first-year retainer)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee and certification of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Ministry of Finance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register setup and initial filing

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, 27 MIRC (Corporations)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Finance and Trade, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation for a Marshall Islands Non-Resident Business Corporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or authorized capital is required and no escrow capital deposit is required before incorporation. Shares may be issued for cash or non-cash consideration as approved by the board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription of 1,000 common shares set forth in the Subscription Agreement; the President and Secretary are authorized to collect the aggregate subscription consideration and record those shares in the share ledger. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation be established at the address of the registered agent named in the Articles of Incorporation, and that said registered agent be retained for service of process. RESOLVED, that [____] be appointed President/Chief Executive Officer, [____] be appointed Secretary, and [____] be appointed Treasurer, each to serve until the next annual election.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (via licensed registered agent or online Registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed exact corporate name, in English, to the Registry for availability search. The name must be distinguishable from existing RMI corporations and must not designate a regulated business unless separately licensed. A clear name may be reserved for 30 days pending filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or reserved to another applicant, submit a second proposed name; a refusal may be appealed to the Registrar by letter within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed resident registered agent / corporate law provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in the form required by the Business Corporations Act, stating corporate name, registered office, registered agent, purpose clause, share authorization and initial directors. The incorporator must execute and acknowledge the Articles; the registered agent must sign the consent.
required_dossiers: Executed and acknowledged Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct drafting errors by preparing amended Articles of Incorporation and resubmission before the Registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry Filing, Examination and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles with the Registrar through the registered agent, pay the statutory filing fee, and record the registered office. The Registrar examines compliance; if satisfied, issues a Certificate of Incorporation and enters the company in the register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a correction request, cure by filing an amendment or explanatory letter within 21 days; repeated refusal can be appealed under the Business Corporations Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Organizational Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent; adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution to accept share subscriptions, adopt Bylaws, fix the registered office, designate the registered agent, and appoint officers. Issue stock certificates against contributions and maintain the share ledger.
required_dossiers: Notice and minutes of first board meeting or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in meeting quorum or consent are cured by circulating a unanimous written consent or reconvening the board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Subscription Settlement and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI or foreign correspondent bank; company's corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate checking account in the company's name and wire or subscribe the paid-in capital, or record non-cash consideration with a board valuation resolution. Obtain bank resolution, signatory cards, and beneficial ownership documentation.
required_dossiers: Board resolution authorizing bank accounts and signatories
Directors' and shareholders' identification with UBO declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Bank information requests are cured by supplying updated UBO declarations, corporate registers, and source-of-funds statements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Foreign Investment and Environmental Licensing for Physical Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Foreign Investment Business Agency / Ministry of Finance and Trade; Majuro municipal licensing; RMI Environment Protection Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the company will physically operate a designer-toy rotocasting and airbrush finishing facility in the RMI, obtain a Foreign Investment Business Permit, municipal operating license, and EPA permit before production. File the low-impact environmental registration with the EPA and obtain fire safety and building inspection clearance. For a pure non-resident business corporation with no RMI physical operations, skip this step and maintain the non-resident status.
required_dossiers: Site lease and municipal zoning approval
Fire safety clearance and building approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiency letters are cured by supplemental plans, lease documents, or environmental compliance schedules; refusal may be appealed to the Minister.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Business Agency / Ministry of Finance and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands; Majuro Municipal Licensing Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Business Permit and Municipal Business Operating License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-Impact Registration and Pollution Prevention Permit; Full EIA Report not required for small-scale designer toy rotocasting, injection, and airbrush finishing operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No unpermitted process wastewater discharge; if authorized, treated effluent shall maintain pH 6-9, TSS below 100 mg/L, and BOD below 50 mg/L. VOC emissions from airbrush booths and rotocasting must be suppressed with filtration and work-practice rules; waste solvents and contaminated materials must be containerized and removed by an EPA-licensed waste hauler.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Majuro Fire Authority, building structural load approval for equipment and storage areas, and occupational workplace clearance covering ventilation, chemical safety, and employee inoculation or hazard communication before production commencement.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance, Revenue and Taxation Division; corporate registration under the Business Corporations Act is administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro. No income-tax filing portal exists because the RMI imposes no corporate income tax; limited fee-based filings are made directly with the Registrar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The RMI does not issue TINs or VAT IDs. A foreign-owned non-resident Business Corporation obtains its corporate registration number from the Registrar of Corporations after presenting articles of incorporation and a declaration of non-resident status. Importers subsequently obtain a customs importer/owner code from RMI Customs Service for duty assessment. No direct tax registration is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - non-resident Business Corporation is exempt from RMI income, withholding, capital gains, and indirect taxation; its only RMI fiscal exposures are customs import duties on physical goods entering the RMI and annual government registration fees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections are available because the RMI has no income tax or CFC regime. An entity may elect exempt-company status under the Business Corporations Act by filing articles of exemption and paying the annual government fee; this is a corporate-status election, not a tax classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duties under the Customs Tariff Act 2001, the RMI's only material transaction-based revenue instrument.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. All persons importing goods into the RMI are subject to customs duty; no minimum economic-turnover registration trigger applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandate for e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping. Import entries are processed by RMI Customs at the point of clearance with electronic manifest filing supported; exporter and invoice records are not required to be fiscally pre-cleared.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. The RMI has no VAT/GST regime, so no 0% export VAT rating or refund mechanism exists. Exported designer toys and collectibles leave the customs territory untaxed; export transactions are outside the scope of RMI customs duty and there is no notional input-tax credit to recover.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration or outward manifest (where goods physically depart the RMI)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export
Customs importer/owner code and any applicable export permits
Not required: VAT refund claim files or inward remittance certificates (no VAT refund system exists)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback regime exists. Misdeclaration or smuggling under the RMI Customs Act attracts seizure, forfeiture, fines up to double the duty, and imprisonment; false statements to the Registrar attract registration and penalty provisions under the Business Corporations Act. The US dollar is legal tender and no statutory repatriation deadline applies; the 180-day parameter reflects prudent banking and AML documentation practice for export proceeds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance - Office of the Banking Commissioner; RMI maintains no standing central bank, and the United States Federal Reserve serves as the de facto monetary authority because the U.S. Dollar is the sole legal tender under the Compact of Free Association.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMI is a fully dollarized jurisdiction with no independent currency and no exchange-control statute. Capital account injections, current account trade settlements, and profit remittances are freely convertible without RMI government approval, withholding, or foreign-investment permit. Residual frictions are confined to U.S. correspondent-bank due diligence and the absence of a domestic interbank FX market, which requires offshore derivative and clearing channels.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, repatriation, or conversion regime applies in RMI: export receipts from designer toy pre-sales, wholesale invoices, and e-commerce settlements may be retained indefinitely in USD with any RMI-licensed or foreign bank, subject only to the account-holding bank's internal AML/CFT monitoring.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. The RMI Banking Act does not license or regulate offshore digital EMIs, so Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, and similar providers operate extra-territorially and may exit or freeze tax-exempt non-resident BCs without local recourse. Shopify Payments and Stripe do not currently support RMI as a direct merchant jurisdiction; a lawfully structured intermediary merchant entity (e.g., a single-member US LLC or HK company) is required to capture those payout rails, with onward USD remittance into the RMI BC treasury account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De facto in-person mandate: RMI banks, under U.S. correspondent-bank pressure, normally require physical appearance of at least one director or authorized signatory at a Majuro branch; Bank of Guam imposes in-branch biometric enrollment, while BOMI occasionally accepts remote video KYC supplemented by apostilled corporate records, notarized director identification, and a current registered-agent attestation. Remote opening is therefore exception-based, not a standard right.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation perceived to lack economic substance when applying for a corporate account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office lease; executed Shopify/Stripe platform service agreements; vinyl-toy subcontract manufacturing contracts; inventory warehouse agreements; trademark filings; and a signed board resolution describing the physical purchase-injection, finishing, and fulfillment chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity inherent in registered-agent-administered RMI structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current Certificate of Incumbency issued by the licensed RMI registered agent; complete register of directors and shareholders; passport copies of all natural-person owners; UBO declarations; and source-of-wealth summaries for each shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk counterparty exposure to People's Republic of China (PRC) vinyl-injection factories and logistics corridors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PRC manufacturing contracts referencing specific factor addresses; commercial invoices; Chinese customs export declarations; maritime bills of lading; and a purchase-order trail harmonized with the RMI BC's sales ledger.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction velocity from global blind-box pre-sales generating high-frequency, low-ticket PSP settlements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shopify Payments/Stripe historical payout statements; refund and chargeback ledgers; shipment tracking logs; and a treasury policy memorandum confirming an e-commerce inventory business model rather than a money-services operation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder equity is injected via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's home-country bank to the RMI BC's beneficiary account at a licensed RMI bank, referenced with purpose code 'Capital Contribution for Business Operations' under RMI Business Corporations Law; USD-only wiring applies because RMI is not a direct Fedwire participant, so interbank clearing occurs through a U.S. correspondent relationship. No RMI exchange-control approval or declaration is required; the initiating bank should attach a board resolution, share-subscription statement, and source-of-funds bank statement to withstand correspondent AML screening.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to PRC vinyl-injection suppliers are executed by SWIFT MT103 USD remittances with commercial invoice references; bulk PVC-resin purchases are financed under UCP600-confirmed Commercial Letters of Credit; prototype, mold-tooling, and small-batch sample payments use telegraphic transfer (T/T) with proforma invoices; EU e-commerce royalty and net-collection sweeps are sent as outgoing MT103 wires; local RMI POS/domestic card rails are inapplicable because finished goods are manufactured in PRC and sold digitally through Shopify and Stripe settlement into the consolidated treasury.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) hedging PRC supplier cost exposure
USD/CNH deliverable FX forwards executed in the offshore CNH market
USD/CNH FX swaps covering working-capital timing mismatches
USD/EUR FX forward contracts stabilizing EU e-commerce net settlement flows
Vanilla USD/CNY call options via OTC international counterparties
Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNH) aligned with multi-year manufacturing supply contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Registrar-prescribed form) confirming registered office, resident agent, directors, shareholders, and share capital
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of incorporation; filing permitted within 60 days after the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 100 per month or fraction thereof; continued non-filing for 3 consecutive years triggers administrative strike-off and loss of legal existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (confidential register update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations, National Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the initial beneficial ownership return; any share transfer or ownership change must be updated within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 10,000 for non-compliance; false or improper disclosure may result in criminal penalties against directors and shareholders.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Continuation Certificate (evidence of maintained resident agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (via licensed resident agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be in effect prior to the annual report filing; renewed on the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a resident agent authorizes the Registrar to appoint one at entity expense or to dissolve the corporation after published notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act, unless the entity is a public issuer, or shareholders holding at least 20% of the voting shares request an audit in writing; standard private low-risk entities are exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP; the Business Corporations Act requires books and records that fairly reflect financial condition and does not mandate a single local GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All natural persons with ultimate controlling ownership or control must be disclosed to the Registrar annually as part of the annual report cycle. Share transfers or any change in beneficial ownership require a dedicated filing within 14 days; the annual confirmation consolidates all prior-year changes and is kept confidential, with access limited to competent authorities.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation: no Marshall Islands income tax, gross revenue tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax is levied on offshore business activities conducted entirely outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Tax-exempt offshore zone regime. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions are available; the only annual government charge is the franchise tax of USD 300 for a non-resident Business Corporation, accompanied by the Registrar of Corporations annual report filing. Exemption is conditioned on the absence of RMI-source income and the timely filing of non-resident declarations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Registrar of Corporations Annual Report and Franchise Tax Statement — Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro; filing is effected by a licensed registered agent through the agent's e-portal or paper submission to the RMI Companies Registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report must be filed on or before the anniversary of incorporation in each year; the USD 300 franchise tax for a Business Corporation is remitted with the report to maintain good standing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, registration number, registered agent, registered office address, and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm non-resident status; list the registered agent's RMI address only; do not list overseas operating premises as the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of current directors, officers, and shareholders, including beneficial ownership information required by the registered agent for AML purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural or corporate shareholders and directors may be appointed; no RMI tax identification number is required, but the registered agent must hold verified identity evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of all business activities carried on within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'No business activity within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.' Global designer blind-box toy merchandising, rotocasting, injection molding, airbrush finishing, and e-commerce sales through Shopify Payments, Stripe, and local POS are not RMI-source activities when performed abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation is not tax resident in the Marshall Islands, derives no RMI-source income, and claims exemption under the offshore regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be executed by a director under penalty of law; a false declaration triggers immediate loss of tax-exempt status, reassessment, and criminal liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual franchise tax due: USD 300 for a non-resident Business Corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit through the registered agent; no income tax computation, no balance sheet, and no audited financial statements are required for the offshore exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Report incurs a late penalty fee plus continuing interest charges; failure to file for twelve consecutive months may result in administrative dissolution by the Registrar. Reinstatement requires payment of all unfiled fees, late penalties, and reinstatement charges, and during dissolution the corporation loses the protection of limited liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporate Income Tax Return — Tax and Revenue Office, Ministry of Finance, Majuro; filing is effected by paper submission or through a licensed tax agent; no fully electronic filing system exists for non-resident exempt corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the last day of the third month following the close of the taxable year (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers). A non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation has no filing obligation unless it unexpectedly derives RMI-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 — Gross Revenue from RMI Sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenue derived from sources within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 0. Do not include worldwide designer toy e-commerce revenue, wholesale receipts, or platform payouts from Shopify Payments, Stripe, or local POS systems outside the RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 — Deductions Allocable to RMI-Source Revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses directly attributable to earning RMI-source gross revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable; leave blank for a non-resident exempt corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income computed after allowable deductions attributable to RMI-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 0; no RMI taxable nexus exists for purely offshore operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RMI 2% gross revenue tax computed on gross revenue derived from business activity carried on within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 0; the non-resident BC conducts no RMI business activity and is not subject to the Gross Revenue Tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 — Tax Credits, Prepayments, and Withholdings
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for tax prepayments, withholding credits, or foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter 0; not applicable to a non-resident exempt corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 — Non-Resident Status and Tax Residence Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident status and identification of the jurisdiction of tax residence, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Check the non-resident box and, if claiming exemption from the Economic Substance Regulations 2019, attach evidence of tax residence in another jurisdiction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Where an RMI income tax return is lawfully due, late filing attracts a penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month of delinquency, up to a maximum of 25%, plus statutory default interest on unpaid tax. Wilful failure to file, or the filing of a false non-resident declaration, is prosecutable as tax evasion and may result in fines, imprisonment, and reassessment of the full RMI tax liability.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a non-resident exempt Business Corporation to its non-resident shareholders; distributions of after-tax offshore profits may be made freely and without RMI statutory withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double tax agreement network; it maintains only a Tax Information Exchange Agreement with the United States. Because no RMI dividend withholding tax exists, there is no treaty rate to invoke. If a shareholder nonetheless requires formal treaty documentation, the shareholder must submit a written application to the RMI Tax and Revenue Office accompanied by certified corporate documents and a non-residency certificate; issuance of an RMI Tax Residency Certificate is generally unavailable to a non-resident tax-exempt BC and would be inconsistent with its offshore status.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rate is 0% for cross-border royalties and debt interest paid by a non-resident exempt Business Corporation to non-resident counterparties; no treaty rate reduction is therefore required. If the BC were to derive RMI-source income or carry on business within the RMI, the Income Tax Act 1989 could subject RMI-source royalty and interest income to tax, but this is inapplicable to the tax-exempt offshore designer toy structure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — the Marshall Islands has not enacted transfer pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting threshold. An arm's length standard would be relevant only if the BC unexpectedly derived RMI-source income and became taxable; in that event, documentation would follow OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, but the non-resident exempt BC has no compliance obligation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations 2019 apply to registered entities that are tax resident in the Marshall Islands and carry on 'relevant activities', which include holding business, intellectual property business, distribution and service center business, and headquarters business. A non-resident BC that is tax resident in another jurisdiction may file a Non-Resident Entity Declaration supported by foreign tax residence evidence to be exempt from the substance test. The designer blind-box toy business (ISIC 3240: rotocasting injection, airbrush finishing, brand IP, and global merchandising) would constitute an intellectual property business if the BC purported to be RMI tax resident; without RMI premises, employees, and core income-generating activities in the RMI, substance cannot be satisfied. The entity must therefore remain non-resident and file the corresponding declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying non-resident tax-exempt status while maintaining inventory, warehousing, employees, distribution, or direct consumer sales within the Marshall Islands through local POS or e-commerce channels, thereby deriving RMI-source gross revenue while paying no RMI income tax or gross revenue tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive revocation of the tax-exempt offshore regime, reassessment of RMI corporate income tax and the 2% gross revenue tax on unreported RMI-source revenue, statutory default interest, penalties of up to 100% of the tax evaded, criminal fines, and imprisonment under the RMI Income Tax Act 1989 and the RMI Criminal Code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are personally exposed to civil restitution of the evaded tax, criminal prosecution, travel bans, asset freezes, and forfeiture orders; the corporate veil is pierced for fraud, and shareholders may be joined to the assessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Marshall Islands Business Corporation as a pure incorporation shell that holds the designer toy brand IP and routes Shopify Payments, Stripe, and POS revenue without any RMI substance, while simultaneously failing to file the Non-Resident Entity Declaration or falsely claiming RMI tax residency to obtain treaty advantages.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Economic Substance Regulations 2019, the RMI Registrar may impose escalating financial penalties, require corrected filings, apply to strike off or dissolve the company, and share information with foreign tax authorities under the TIEA; the tax exemption may be voided retroactively.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent incur personal liability for repeated substance compliance failures; RMI courts may disqualify directors, order restitution of avoided taxes, impose travel bans, and compel dissolution of the shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach — Concealment and Payment Rail Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the ultimate beneficial owner through bearer share practices, nominee directors, or undisclosed trust arrangements; failing to maintain KYC and transaction monitoring records for designer blind-box toy sales routed through Shopify Payments, Stripe, or local POS; layering proceeds through crypto exchanges, prepaid cards, or unrelated third-party payment processors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2010, the entity and its registered agent face financial penalties of up to USD 500,000, suspension or revocation of the agent's license, asset forfeiture, and criminal prosecution for money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal fines, imprisonment, travel bans, and clawback of laundered proceeds; the limited liability shield is removed where the BC is used as an instrument of fraud or financial crime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repatriating designer toy profits through shareholder dividends while the company is technically insolvent or while trade creditors for rotocasting, vinyl injection molding, mold tooling, airbrush finishing supplies, and logistics remain unpaid; or declaring dividends from stated capital rather than accumulated surplus.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, unlawful distributions must be restored to the company; the court may order liquidation, clawback of distributions, and voidance of related transactions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who assent to a wrongful distribution are jointly and severally liable for the full amount distributed; for fraud the court will pierce the corporate veil, and enforcement may include civil restitution, travel bans, and seizure of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI corporate vehicle or associated shipping or logistics channels to export designer blind-box toys containing restricted vinyl, resin, or chemical materials, or to transact with sanctioned jurisdictions, denied parties, or embargoed payment channels without export control and sanctions screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI sanctions enforcement, international embargo penalties, customs forfeiture, loss of RMI registry privileges, detention of cargo or vessels, and listing on sanctions databases; significant financial penalties may be imposed by the RMI and by foreign regulators with jurisdiction over the payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly facilitate sanctioned transactions face criminal prosecution, personal fines, travel bans, and seizure of overseas assets; the corporate form does not shield wilful misconduct or intentional violation of sanctions laws.
